name: coolify-deploy
description: Coolify deployment toolkit for Docker Compose services, resource-safe builds, database migrations, logs, and CLI setup.

interface.shortDescription: Guide resource-safe Coolify deploys, DB flows, logs, and CLI setup
interface.longDescription: Coolify deployment workflow for Docker Compose applications. It bundles four skills: coolify-deploy for compose, Dockerfile, env, TLS, rollback, and host resource admission; coolify-db for role isolation and migrations; coolify-logs for build, runtime, OOM, and disk-failure debugging; and coolify-setup for CLI, token, and permission setup.
defaultPrompt: 用 coolify-deploy 幫我寫 docker-compose.yml
用 coolify-deploy 檢查這台主機是否有足夠 RAM 安全部署
用 coolify-logs 看這次 Coolify 部署為什麼失敗
用 coolify-db 規劃 Postgres migration 與唯讀存取
